title: One Piece Made It Impossible to Ignore How Much the Creator Favors Sanji Over Zoro, And Fans Can’t Deny It
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the One Piece manga! The debate regarding Zoro and Sanji’s powers may never be settled among fans, but One Piece ‘s creator has his own plans regarding the characters. As the Wings of the Pirate King, there’s no denying that Zoro and Sanji are not only Luffy’s most powerful allies, but they also have a huge role in the story. While Zoro is the first mate and a swordsman, Sanji is the cherished chef of the crew, on top of being an incredible fighter. Zoro and Sanji have been neck and neck with each other in terms of powers and their contribution to the story.

There’s no denying that Luffy needs both of them to become the pirate king . Even so, every fan has their favorite among these two, and the fan discourse often becomes as heated as their rivalry. However, after almost 30 years of serialization, it’s becoming evident that not only fans but even the creator, Eiichiro Oda, has a favorite among these two. Sanji is often considered one of the best-written characters in Shonen, and it’s all thanks to the effort Oda has put into him throughout these decades. Now that the Elbaph Arc is nearing its end, it’s more evident than ever that Oda has favored Sanji on multiple occasions.

Sanji’s Character Development Is the Best in One Piece & It’s Not Even Close

Sanji’s development happens over the decades, and it continues on even now. Ever since his introduction, he stood out as someone with strong morals. He was unapologetically kind, caring, and even goofy, which is why he immediately became a fan-favorite character. However, it didn’t take long for the story to reveal a part of his backstory when he met Zeff as a child and survived after being stranded on an island for weeks. This experience taught him the value of food, and he never spent a day wasting anything for the rest of his life. However, that tragic backstory only scratched the surface since Sanji’s life had been extremely difficult long before he came to the East Blue.

The story continues to feature his journey ever since his introduction in the Baratie Arc as he gets more powerful over the years. While the story also dropped subtle hints about his origins, especially in the Skypiea Arc when he mentioned he was from North Blue, the series didn’t give a concrete hint about his true past. It wasn’t until the Whole Cake Island Arc that the series revealed his origins and his horrible childhood when he suffered abuse from his family. Coming from a family of elite fighters who relied on genetic modifications, Sanji was discarded when he failed to meet his father’s expectations.

The trauma and struggles he faced during his childhood shaped him into the person he is today and guided his actions throughout his life. The arc was solely dedicated to him and his development, where he not only came to terms with his past but also completely broke ties with his family after saving them from Big Mom. Without the burden of his past, he reached new heights of power, especially after awakening his Germa 66 powers. The series has been progressing his story over the years, and every minor development comes together in the Elbaph Arc where he awakens his Conqueror’s Haki .

Sanji’s Conqueror’s Haki Awakening Has a Much Deeper Meaning Than Fans Realize

At this point, it’s pretty evident that Sanji’s Conqueror’s Haki is the result of his journey over the years . Sanji’s development doesn’t stop in the Whole Cake Island Arc when he severed ties with his family, but that was only the beginning of what we were going to see from him. Everything he faced in the Whole Cake Island Arc helped him overcome his past traumas and accept himself for who he is. Although he never showed it, he dealt with self-loathing and lack of self-worth. His self-sacrificial nature allowed him to even risk his life for his friends, but he would never want to rely on them. Even though he became stronger after escaping his family in childhood, the idea that he was worthless was deeply ingrained in Sanji’s mind, which led him to believe he shouldn’t ask others for help.

However, this all changed in the Wano Country Arc when he faced Black Maria, an opponent he could have easily defeated if she wasn’t a woman. Sanji would rather die than actually hit a woman, which is why he asked Robin for help. He not only trusted her abilities but also relied on her since he had nowhere to escape. This is a stark contrast compared to Enies Lobby when he couldn’t fight Kalifa and Nami had to interfere. He never asked her for help, but she decided to save him anyway. Not only that, but his experience on Ivankov’s island also taught him self-love, which was more important than any ordinary training.

He always had the potential to awaken his Conqueror’s Haki sooner if only he wasn’t held back by his own inner demons. In Chapter 1197, he finally overcame his long-standing self-loathing, which is the biggest reason he was able to tap into this power. The awakening seems even more meaningful because it is proof of his self-acceptance. He remembered Ivankov’s words and finally understood that the love he felt for his crew and those he cared about is worthless if he keeps treating himself as disposable. This is why his awakening is one of the most memorable moments in the series. His journey is far from over, and there’s no telling how much further he will go now that he has the one power he needed the most.

Zoro Never Got As Much Attention As Sanji in One Piece

There’s no denying that Zoro will always be one of the most beloved Shonen characters, but when it comes to character writing, he always falls behind Sanji. Not only does has one of the most underwhelming backstories in the series , but he never got an arc solely dedicated to him. Fans had high expectations for his character writing in Wano, but the series only glossed over his true lineage without revealing much about his past. It was so underwhelming that at this point, the story wouldn’t change much even if fans forget he belongs to a legendary noble clan of Wano. Regardless, the main issue lies with the fact that he mostly shines in battles, but the story of One Piece is so much more than just cool fights.

This is why Sanji has the upper hand since he draws fans in with his emotional story and themes of self-love and acceptance. We also can’t forget that Zoro’s Conqueror’s Haki awakening, which was an anticipated moment, is considerably underwhelming when compared to Sanji. Instead of featuring his development, the series rand3omly showed him knocking down some of Kaido’s men during a conflict, and that was it. For the first mate to awaken such a legendary power , there’s no excuse as to why this scene was so underwhelming. When compared to Sanji, Zoro’s awakening scene feels even less exciting, and the difference will be even more evident in the anime series.

What do you think about Sanji’s development over the years? Does he overshadow Zoro in terms of writing and character depth? Share your thoughts in the comments below.

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Star Breaks Down Her Character’s Big Change for Sequel [EXCLUSIVE]
content:
Godzilla Minus Zero is now tearing its way through theaters worldwide with one of the best box office openings for Toho’s long running franchise yet , and the star behind Noriko, Minami Hamabe, opened up to ComicBook about her character’s big change in the sequel film. Godzilla Minus One introduced Noriko to the franchise as someone who barely survived one of Godzilla’s initial attacks, only then to reveal she indeed was able to make it out of all of that alive in the end. But as revealed in the sequel, that came with some unexpected side effects.

Godzilla Minus Zero reveals that Noriko was able to survive the film thanks to the G Cells that had made it into her body, and she had subsequently mutated as a result. Speaking to ComicBook about this change in her character and her resulting link with Godzilla as a result, Hamabe explains that while Godzilla is positioned differently in this sequel due to this impact on Noriko and the arrival of a new threat , Noriko herself is still far from seeing the famous kaiju as a hero of some sort as it’s still a “symbol of fear in a lot of ways.”

Godzilla Minus Zero ‘s Noriko Talks G Cells and Link to Godzilla

“Noriko for me still sees Godzilla as this symbol of fear in a lot of ways,” Hamabe began. “It represents fear itself, and it’s threatening everything that the characters in post-war Japan are trying to rebuild.” Elaborating on this threat, Hamabe explained that while Noriko’s direct link to Godzilla changed her perspective on it, this is still far from seeing it with anything other than object fear , “So I think there’s still a very strong hatred towards Godzilla and what it represents in Minus Zero because Noriko and Godzilla now have this link, it certainly changes slightly, but I don’t think that means Noriko sees Godzilla in any positive light.”

Digging into it further, Hamabe then revealed just how complex of a situation it really is for Noriko, “And for audiences who are seeing it, I think you can kind of feel there’s a very complex feeling that Noriko has towards Godzilla whenever even the word or idea of Godzilla crosses her mind on screen.” Although there’s a new threat that makes Godzilla seems like the lesser of two evils, it’s still something that Noriko doesn’t want to call on even with her connection, “Especially because she understands with King Ghidorah in the mix now , Godzilla is positioned differently in the larger landscape. But all said, I think Godzilla is still something that Noriko doesn’t want to see at any moment.”

Will Godzilla Minus Zero Get a Sequel?

Although all of the promotional materials for Godzilla Minus Zero touted that there would not be a third film to cap off a trilogy, the final moments of the film are clearly setting up for the next phase of the story . Koichi and Noriko have since escaped the clutches of the United States government, and her direct connection with Godzilla and the G Cells makes her more important that ever before. Especially because it’s clear that the G Cells also won’t be keeping Noriko alive forever. There’s a time limit on it all.

It’s possible for this take on Godzilla to end here, but it also seems like there’s still much more to explore for both Koichi and Noriko as the two of them just want to live peaceful lives after everything their small family has been through. But would you want to see the Godzilla Minus franchise returning for a third film? What would you want to see go down in it? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Netflix Drops New Trailer for Major Horror Anime Debut Coming This Month – Watch
content:
A new Horror anime series is coming to Netflix later this month, and a new trailer is helping to show how two legendary anime studios have helped to bring its original manga to life. Kasumi Yasuda’s Fool Night originally made its debut in the pages of Shogakukan’s Big Comic Superior in 2020 , and six years later the franchise is coming to screens with its official anime adaptation. But while it might have missed out on the spooky season, it’s going to be a chilling Fall entry.

Fool Night is set to make its debut with Netflix later this month , and has dropped a full new trailer showing off the best look at its new anime yet. While previous trailers and promotional images have only scratched the surface, Netflix has now revealed the extended voice cast, theme songs, and more as it gears up for its premiere. To celebrate, you can check out the newest trailer for Fool Night below.

Fool Night Releases Trailer Ahead of November 2026 Netflix Debut

Fool Night will be making its worldwide debut with Netflix on November 26th , and all of its episodes are going to be available at once. It’s also a joint production between two of the most legendary anime franchise studios with Atsuyuki Yukawa directing the anime for Sunrise ( Mobile Suit Gundam ) and Shaft ( Puella Magi Madoka Magica ), Ryo Shimura as assistant director, Jin Tanaka handling the series composition, Robert Sato providing the character designs, and Tatsuya Kato composing the music.

The opening theme revealed with the release of this trailer is titled “Shake! spit out” as performed by Tempalay, and the new ending theme is titled “Iki” as performed by Nowlu. The full voice cast has been revealed as well with new additions including Shion Wakayama as Sumi Matsuno, Hiroshi Tsuchida as Ken Hikasa ( which comes shortly after the actor’s passing earlier this month ), Nobuhiko Okamoto as Nishi, Sayaka Senbongi as Meg Okumura, and Yumiko Kobayashi as Ivy. A new poster has been revealed showing off more of the anime’s characters too, and you can check it out below.

What to Know for Fool Night Anime

These newest voice cast additions join the previously announced cast of Koki Uchiyama as Toshiro Kamiya, Minako Kotobuki as Yomiko Horai, Junya Enoki as Akira Yatsuka, Aya Endo as Saeko Kanaeno, and Kiyomitsu Mizuuchi as Jin Hiragishi. There’s also going to be an English dub led by Adam McArthur as Toshiro and Olivia Liang as Yomiko releasing along the Japanese audio version too, but the voice actors for the rest of the characters have yet to be revealed as of this time. It’s going to be a spooky science fiction adventure for those looking forward to it.

Fool Night is set in a post-apocalyptic version of the future where oxygen is running so low, humanity is forced to plant seeds in those dying in order to spread plants wherever possible in a process known as “Transfloration.” Though the anime unfortunately won’t be a weekly release where fans can break it all down as seen with hits like JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure: Steel Ball Run also airing this Fall , the binge release might work out better for it in the long run. Are you going to check out Fool Night on Netflix? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: Sword Art Online Creator Returns With New Anime – Watch Opening Now
content:
The creator behind Sword Art Online has a new anime streaming new episodes this Fall, and Devils’ Crest has dropped a cool opening theme sequence to celebrate its premiere. Reki Kawahara has released one of the most notable light novel franchises of all time with Sword Art Online, but the creator has had a lot of success with other notable releases over the years. Kawahara’s newest work has been a big hit with fans as well, but now it’s reached a whole new level with its official anime adaptation debut .

Devils’ Crest has now made its long awaited anime debut as one of the final new releases for the Fall 2026 anime schedule . Premiering with its first two episodes, the series introduces fans to a new deadly video game world with young protagonists stuck inside of it and forced to fight for their lives. To celebrate the debut of the anime, you can check out the creditless version of its opening below titled “Shinka” as performed by Ado.

Devils’ Crest Debuts New Opening Along With Anime’s Premiere

Devils’ Crest has now officially made its worldwide streaming debut with Prime Video as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule , and the first two episodes of the series are available to watch as of this time. This new anime is directed by Kenichiro Komaya for Production I.G. with Shinji Ushiro serving as chief director, Eiji Umehara providing the scripts, Yuki Hayashi composing the music, and original light novel artist Yukiko Horiguchi providing the character designs. It’s got quite the huge cast of characters behind it too.

Devils’ Crest features an expanded voice cast including the likes of Haruka Shiraishi as Yuma Ashihara, Konomi Inagaki as Sawa Ashihara, Yuya Hirose as Kenji Kondo, Satomi Amano as Minagi Sano, Yusuke Kobayashi as Teruki Sugamo, Maaya Uchida as Aria Misono, Rie Murakawa as Kai Kisanuki, Sora Amamiya as Sumika Watamaki, Atsushi Tamaru as Shin Haizaki, and Ayumu Murase as Kakeru Niki. But by the looks of this opening we’ll see even more cast members joining the anime in the near future.

What to Know for Devils’ Crest

Devils’ Crest does cover a lot of the same ground as Sword Art Online at first as a class full of children find themselves trapped within the world of a popular virtual reality game, and the middle schoolers then need to navigate the fights of their lives. It’s a lot hard hitting thanks to the younger ages of each of the characters, and the central hook is that the main protagonist’s sister finds herself possessed by a strange presence. But with the anime now releasing its episodes, fans will get to see how it evolves from here.

If you’re itching for more of Sword Art Online instead, thankfully there’s more of that franchise now in the works as well. Sword Art Online the Movie -Integral Domain- has been announced as a brand new movie now in the works for a release in theaters across Japan sometime in 2028, but not a lot of concrete information for it has been confirmed outside of the fact that Yoshitsugu Matsuoka and Haruka Tomatsu are reprising their roles as Kirito and Asuna, respectively.

Have you checked out Devils’ Crest new anime premiere? What do you think of its opening? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

If you’re itching for more of Sword Art Online instead, thankfully there’s more of that franchise now in the works as well. Sword Art Online the Movie -Integral Domain- has been announced as a brand new movie now in the works for a release in theaters across Japan sometime in 2028, but not a lot of concrete information for it has been confirmed outside of the fact that Yoshitsugu Matsuoka and Haruka Tomatsu are reprising their roles as Kirito and Asuna, respectively.
Have you checked out Devils’ Crest new anime premiere? What do you think of its opening? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments.

title: One-Punch Man Season 3 Shows Off Its Heroes & Monsters Ahead of 2027 Return
content:
One-Punch Man is gearing up to return for the next half of Season 3 next year, and the anime is showing off a closer look at its returning heroes and monsters ahead of its big comeback. One-Punch Man has had a rough road for the anime over the last few years. While it might be currently celebrating the 10th anniversary of its original debut, the anime is not seen in as good of a light as it was seen in back then . But that could change.

One-Punch Man Season 3 was on the right path with the first half of its season last year, and proved to be such a big hit that it quickly confirmed that the anime would be returning for more of the season in 2027 . As we get closer to its January 2027 launch, One-Punch Man Season 3 has dropped a new update revealing some new character posters for the first of its returning heroes and monsters roster in the coming season. You can check them out below.

When Does One-Punch Man Season 3 Come Out?

One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2 is scheduled to be making its debut sometime in January 2027 as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule , but a more concrete release date or streaming platform has yet to be announced as of this time. The English language release of the new season has been licensed by Viz Media, and you can catch up with the second and third seasons now streaming with Hulu and Hulu on Disney+ in the meantime. It’s likely that the new episodes will be streaming with those platforms as well.

Along with these newly revealed character posters it was also confirmed that Makoto Furukawa (the voice actor behind Saitama) will be performing the ending theme for the new episodes titled “Wakusei no Katasumi,” and he’s previously performed the ending themes in the anime’s second and third seasons as well . The new opening theme was previously revealed to be titled “Never Done -SUPREME POWER VS ULTIMATE FEAR-” as performed by the also returning JAM Project.

What to Know for One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2

One-Punch Man will likely continue to divide fans with the second half of this third season because it retains much of the staff that had been seen with the divisive second and third seasons. Shinpei Nagai returns from the previous season to direct the new episodes for J.C. Staff with Tomohiro Suzuki providing the series composition, Makoto Miyazaki composing the music, and Chikashi Kubota, Shinjiro Kuroda, and Ryosuke Shirakawa providing the character designs.

One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2 continues through the massive Monster Association Saga that the first half of the season left off with, and there are some huge fights that are coming to the anime in the near future. But while the series indeed has some big moments ahead, it’s also not quite clear if the anime will make it to those events within this second half. Some of that stuff might not hit until Season 4 at the earliest, and that’s just something that’s not guaranteed . But what are you hoping to see in One-Punch Man’ s return for Season 3 next year? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: LEGO Ninjago to Return in 2027 With New Anime – Watch First Look Trailer
content:
LEGO Ninjago is making a big return next year with a new anime offering a whole new upgraded look for the long running franchise, and has dropped the first trailer showing off what fans can expect to see. While LEGO might be more widely known these days by older collectors who are seeking out more collectible versions of major franchises , there are still some major brands that have managed to carve out their own path for nearly two decades at this point like LEGO Ninjago.

LEGO Ninjago is one of the coolest sets that LEGO has ever released on shelves, and it’s only been getting more intense in the 15 years since the line’s original launch with all sorts of animated projects that have offered new takes on its universe . Now the franchise is coming back to screens next year with the first look at a new anime, LEGO NINJAGO Legends: Embers + Ashes , and you can check out the first trailer for the new anime below.

LEGO NINJAGO Legends: Embers + Ashes Debuts First Trailer Ahead of 2027 Release

LEGO NINJAGO Legends: Embers + Ashes is currently scheduled for a release sometime in 2027, but has yet to confirm a concrete release date or platforms as of the time of this writing. The LEGO Group has also yet to reveal any of the production information behind the anime, but it’s teased to be a full series when it hits. It’s also teased to be continuing the long running Ninjago storyline that has been active since 2011, but will be staring a new generation of ninjas as they are now on their respective journeys in the new anime.

LEGO NINJAGO Legends: Embers + Ashes follows in the recent slate of NINJAGO Legends animated shorts that have been released over the past few years, with the latest, NINJAGO Legends: DuskFall , launching earlier this Spring. There’s even a few clues as to what to expect from the new anime with the first collectible set hitting shelves next January with Ivo’s Ninja Dojo. There’s going to be a lot more to piece together as it looks like Ninjago is reaching for a slightly older audience with this next anime adventure.

What’s the Deal With LEGO Ninjago ?

LEGO Ninjago first made its debut in 2011 as Ninjago: Masters of Spinjitzu , it was a more action forward LEGO collection that introduced fans to a line up of elemental ninjas who had used spinning top like movements to fight. It was a notable shift for the building blocks themselves, and it was such a hit that the franchise went on to inspire a CG animated series that ran for over a decade with 15 seasons before it all came to an end. But that was far from everything that fans would see from it over the years.

Ninjago then went on to inspire The LEGO Ninjago Movie that introduced a new timeline , and multiple other animated projects and efforts over the years. But this anime makeover for the franchise is the most fitting release for it yet. It’s always felt like Ninjago had been dancing around its anime inspirations, and now the franchise gets to fully dive in.

How are you feeling about this anime update for LEGO Ninjago ‘s next big project? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Gacha Girls Corps Anime Premieres January 7
content:
Gacha Girls Corps anime announced a January 7, 2027 premiere date. A main visual and two additional cast members were also released. Joining the cast are Aimi Ozawa as Migle and Renon Esumi as Lennon.

A trailer was previously released. Takashi Asami is directing the anime at studios Zero-G and Saber Works. Deko Akao is in charge of series composition, while Minewo Suzuki is in charge of character designs. Hiroaki Tsutsumi and George King are composing the music. The cast includes:

• Daisuke Sakaguchi as Heihachi Okura

• Miyu Tomita as Norl Fanya

• Iori Noguchi as Estelle

Gacha Girls Corps is a light novel series written by Chinkururi with illustrations provided by Yasutaka Isekawa. It was originally launched as a web novel on the Shosetsuka ni Naro website in January 2016. Micro Magazine then published nine volumes in print under their GC Novels imprint from November 2016 to August 2020.

Syuu Haruno illustrated the manga adaptation, which began its serialization in Micro Magazine’s Comic Ride online magazine in March 2018. Kaiten Books is licensing the manga in English and they describe it as:

UR-GUARANTEED—TO HAVE THE ADVENTURE OF A LIFETIME! Ready for an adventure that’s out of this world? We’ve gacha covered. Norl’s a cutting-edge cutie with a cutting edge who’s a cut above the rest. Heihachi’s just your average mobile game addict with a whale-sized hole in his wallet. But one day, he pulls an item that pulls him into another world, spinning his life around with a spin of the gacha. Attacked by monsters, and left without options, Heihachi does what he knows best—roll gacha! To his surprise, he watches his unit materialize before his eyes. Heihachi’s used to seeing cute girls pop up on his phone, but he’s never seen one pop out of his phone! Join him on his quest to collect OP UR QTs! (That’s Overpowered Ultra Rare Cuties.)

title: There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero’s Party, so I Tried Confessing to Her Anime Gets Season 2
content:
There Was a Cute Girl in the Hero’s Party, so I Tried Confessing to Her anime is getting Season 2. The sequel’s release date has yet to be revealed. The first season premiered on January 6, 2026.

Staff:

• Chief Director: Yasutaka Yamamoto

• Director: Tomonori Mine

• Series Composition & Script: Yukie Sugawara

• Character Design: Mina Osawa

• Music: Satoru Kosaki & MONACA

• Animation Production: Gekko

• Producer: Ryo Aizawa (Starry Cube)

Cast:

• Kohei Amasaki as Yoki

• Kana Hanazawa as Cecilia

• Ryohei Kimura as Yuga

• Yuko Natsuyoshi as Mikana

• Toshiki Masuda as Duke

• Minami Tanaka as Seek

Suisei wrote the light novel which the anime is based on, and La-na illustrated it. It was initially launched on Shosetsuka ni Naro in July 2013. Futabasha published three volumes under its Monster Bunko imprint between October 2014 and August 2015. A manga adaptation by Kairi is serialized on Manga Gaogao and Gaogao Monster Plus .

The romantic fantasy comedy follows Yoki, a former human who gets reincarnated as a demon in another world. His peaceful life as a mid-level boss in the Demon Lord’s castle is changed when he falls in love with Cecilia, a kind yet strong-willed cleric from the hero’s party. Despite being admired by his subordinates, Yoki turns shy and awkward around her.

title: Everyone's Darling Has a Secret Reveals Additional Cast, Ending Theme Song
content:
Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret anime has three additional cast and the ending theme song. Aiiro Impulse, the in-story idol unit consisting of Rei Kuromiya (voiced by Hikaru Tono), Sakura Akai (voiced by Iori Noguchi), and Sora Konno (voiced by Ai Maeshima), performs the ending theme song“Naritai Watashi.” The additional cast is as follows:

• Aimi Ozawa as Hofu

• Renon Esumi as Saito

• Aoi Onishi as Okaba

Studio Gekko is animating the series, and it is set to premiere in April 2027. The previously announced voice cast consists of:

• Reiji Kawashima as Hizashi Hiruno

• Hikaru Tono as Rei Kuromiya

• Iori Noguchi as Sakura Akai

• Ami Maeshima as Sora Konno

Hikaru Sato is directing the anime, with Fumihiko Shimo in charge of the series scripts. Kibidango 14-go is the character designer, while Satoru Kosaki and MONACA compose the music.

Kashiko Amane writes and illustrates the manga that the anime is based on. Hakusensha is publishing the manga since September 2022. Yen Press is licensing it in English, describing the plot as follows: Hizashi Hiruno, a freshman at a super-elite high school, has just finished his first academic proficiency test of the year. He anxiously awaits the results, which will set the tone for his next three years at school. But due to a mistake on his answer sheet, he receives an abysmal score and gets sent to remedial lessons! If there’s one silver lining, he’s not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?! Source: Everyone’s Darling Has a Secret anime official X (formerly Twitter) , Website © Kashiko Amane / Hakusensha / Blue Impulse/ StarryCube

title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Confirms English Dub Release Date With Crunchyroll – Watch New Trailer
content:
Dragon Ball Super has finally confirmed the release date for the English dub of its new remake series, and Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is coming for dub fans very soon. Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has been showing off a whole new take on the now classic TV anime series from over a decade ago , and the first few episodes have revealed how this new era is going to be enhancing the Battle of Gods arc. But unfortunately, fans of the English dub release have had to wait a little longer.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is currently a few episodes into its run as of the latest episodes of the anime hitting screens this Fall, and thankfully Crunchyroll has now confirmed that the English dub of the new remake series will be streaming with the platform beginning on November 12th at 8:00AM PT. To celebrate the confirmation of the release date, Crunchyroll has released a special new trailer showing off the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus English dub that you can check out below.

Crunchyroll Confirms Dragon Ball Super: Beerus English Dub Release Date

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus’ English dub release will be making its debut with Crunchyroll on November 12th at 8:00AM PT, and new episodes will then be releasing on a weekly basis from then on for fans in the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, and Latin America. They will also be streaming the Spanish and Portuguese dubs at the same time as well, and will be featuring a returning voice cast from each of the dubs as well . The currently confirmed returning members of each cast breaks down as such:

ENGLISH VOICE CAST

• Son Goku: Sean Schemmel

• Vegeta: Christopher R. Sabat

• Beerus: Jason Douglas

• Whis: Ian Sinclair

SPANISH VOICE CAST

• Son Goku: Mario Castañeda

• Vegeta: René Garcia

• Beerus: José Luis Orozco

• Whis: Arturo Castañeda

PORTUGUESE VOICE CAST

• Son Goku: Wendel Bezerra

• Vegeta: Alfredo Rollo

• Beerus: Marcelo Pissardini

• Whis: Felipe Grinan

What Does This Mean for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus’ Future?

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is currently streaming the Japanese language version of the anime on a weekly basis with other platforms such as Hulu and Netflix, but it’s currently unclear as to whether or not the English dub release will stream with those platforms as well. There are also other questions about the nature of the dub’s production for each language as well as members of the Japanese production have previously noted that they didn’t need to record any new dialogue for the new remake series.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has featured enhanced versions of the classic TV anime’s events with new visual effects, new cuts of animation , new sound effects and more. But while there have been a few new recordings for the remake series with some of the Japanese actors, for the most part it’s been repurposing the older audio for the new era. It’s likely going to be the same case for each of the dub releases as well, but we’ll have to see whether or not that’s really the case when they kick off their run later this month.

Are you excited for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus to kick off its English dub release? Which moments are you most excited to see in action? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!
